goal: Complete pre-cycle4 feature lock audit for Android-owned areas and publish reproducible emulator plus physical-device evidence for product journey and navigation wiring stability.

inputs.description: Canonical matrix for Android ownership rows.
Current accepted baseline and governance lock.
Navigation graph for mode wiring validation.

constraints.notes: Evidence must include both emulator and physical-device reruns in the same cycle window, with sanitized logs and reproducible steps.

acceptance: Android-owned audit matrix rows have explicit verdicts (pass/partial/blocked) with evidence paths.
Write/save/re-open/re-query/universe journey is rerun on emulator and physical device and documented in the same run window.
Navigation wiring health across Home/Stream/Desk/Chronos/Universe is validated with concrete references.

risk.note: Missing physical-device rerun evidence is an explicit pre-cycle4 gate failure even if emulator checks pass.

next_actions: Run product journey validation on emulator and physical device and capture evidence.
Audit navigation graph and fragment wiring and mark pass/partial/blocked with references.
Publish android pre-cycle4 result artifact and update Android report sections for this cycle window.
